author: greg thomas
text: I can’t say enough good things! They got to me unexpectedly quick. They were nice and professional and the job price was great. They navigated a steep drive with no problem. I’m impressed!

author: Liz Mays
text: Would highly recommend calling them to anyone needing septic tank services. They showed up the same day I called. They found my septic tank, digged it out,  and pumped it out. Got the job done properly and quickly. Was very surprised at the low cost fees they charged for both pumping my septic tank and finding and digging it up. Their AWESOME.

text:

author: Courtney Threadgill
text: We called Lindsey's on Thursday and by Saturday morning they had my septic tank emptied. Great customer service and you can't beat their prices.

author: Matt Mudd
text: Very unprofessional. Left without doing the job and still charged $75. What a joke.
